opus.problem: The 'eye of a needle' saying is one of the best-known lines in the Gospels. Most bakers would guess 'camel' from this clue alone, which breaks the rule that no single clue gives the word away.

The detail that Isaac was out in the field at evening comes from Genesis 24:63, not the cited verse. Genesis 24:64 only says Rebekah looked up, saw Isaac and got down from her camel. Either cite Genesis 24:63-64 or drop the field and evening detail.
